setup.selection_rationale: Immediate following calendar year after opened 2016 positive, chosen and frozen before reading 2017 heights
setup.primary_test: same individual/5km cell, own other-day wind-regime-conditional probability distribution of session-median-centred native GPS altitudes versus own other-day wind-pooled
setup.wind_data: CERRA via Open-Meteo at four 2016-frozen colony centroid coordinates, site-month calendar wind_speed_100m quartiles, 2017 May-Jul

execution.regression: synthetic and immutable source GitHub Actions jobs both succeeded

across_2016_2017.independence_warning: Same Movebank archive, same colony environment, 11 repeated bird IDs, and possibly shared devices. The two year p-values are NOT independent study replications to combine by Fisher meta-analysis.

valid_claim: Among individually GPS-tracked Larus fuscus in two consecutive breeding seasons, colony-scale wind regime provides repeatable held-out-day information about the shape of the within-day-centred vertical flight-use distribution beyond a wind-pooled individual baseline. This is an observational prediction pattern.
invalid_claims: Causal wind control or adaptive mechanism proven
Bird-level wind reaction strengths personally stable across years
Local winds at each GPS flight fix accurately measured
Independent taxonomic replication in two species
An axis-general ecological law proven for the MINA penguin breeding concentration
evidence_source: 2017 primary run 39404195393 and outcome-blind run 39403638754; 2016 run 39401802547
